title: CardMesh
summary: The first Cardputer Zero app for Meshtastic, MeshCore, and remote MeshMonitor co
description:
CardMesh is the first application developed specifically for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero, bringing Meshtastic, MeshCore, and remote MeshMonitor connectivity together in a unified, keyboard-first pocket client.

It communicates directly with Meshtastic and MeshCore LoRa mesh networks through the onboard LoRa HAT, operating one protocol at a time on the shared physical radio, with seamless switching at the tap of a button. Remote MeshMonitor connectivity is provided through its REST API.

An intuitive icon-grid home screen provides quick access to all three platforms, each featuring its own channel picker and chat interface, delivering a dedicated, portable mesh communications experience.
